sample.fit_membership: real sampled fitting groups; labels and weights used only for fit cache construction

admission.reason: The projected complete-panel known cost exceeds the frozen ceiling before grading and remaining delivery costs.

projected_panel_cost_seconds.basis: Profile R2 linearly scales sampled cache sequences, normalizer sequences, fit batches, and evaluation groups to the full two-fold recipe.

first_epoch_jit_sensitivity.assumption: Treat the first epoch's excess over the mean of its later epochs as one-time JIT overhead that is not repeated in the full-panel production path.

accounting.limitation: The adjusted panel projection is an optimistic sensitivity calculation. R2 did not directly measure the cost of JIT warmup in the production process topology.

storage_and_io.finding: The full cache plus parent and candidate predictions is about 32.90 GB. Available disk capacity was adequate at review time, but the cache projection extrapolates from only 4 fit and 2 evaluation groups per fold; cold full-cache I/O was not observed.

unmeasured_costs: Full official target grading, including component bootstrap intervals
Candidate provenance and sidecar serialization beyond the sampled export analogue
Cold full-cache I/O and complete-cache hashing at scale
Thermal scheduling overhead during the eventual full run

review_findings.finding: The profile's projected known cost is 10804.25 seconds, already 1804.25 seconds over the 9000-second ceiling. Even the optimistic one-time-JIT adjustment leaves 9925.09 seconds before unmeasured costs.
review_findings.consequence: Do not admit any scientific head fits from R2; preserve the complete panel intact.

review_findings.finding: The largest projected phase is full cache generation at 6548.53 seconds. It is scaled from 12 sampled sequence groups to 3404 full fit/evaluation groups and about 31.86 GB of sequence caches.
review_findings.consequence: Treat cold full-cache I/O as unverified until a revised profile measures the source-open, parent-batch, and cache-write phases with adequate sample coverage.

review_findings.finding: Grading, production provenance, full-cache hash traffic, and thermal scheduling are absent from the known-cost sum.
review_findings.consequence: Reserve these costs explicitly in the next admission calculation; do not spend the full 9000 seconds on the projected phases alone.

follow_up.planned_changes: Measure parent inference with the common sequence batch size of 8, isolate fixed source-footer opens, record one-time JIT warmup separately, and use 16 fit plus 8 evaluation sequences per fold.
follow_up.admission_condition: Reconcile the revised full-panel projection with prior charges and conservative grading, provenance, I/O, and thermal reserves; otherwise defer the complete panel.

limitations: Read-only resource and arithmetic review. No candidate artifacts, target labels for evaluation, official scores, scientific fits, or GPU work were inspected or run. The projection is empirical and sample-derived, not a mathematical lower bound or a quality result.
